summary: Yesterday's synchronized flush only half unwound. NQ never repaired: it rallied to tag its stop and RTH high early, failed, faded to a fresh 28,212.50 low, and closed -1.51% still short below 28,632.42. ES and gold clawed marginally back above their flip lines, but both sit under their AVWAPs, so these are fragile long flips, not clean reversals. Crude gave back about a third of its supply-shock spike, -2.11%, and flipped short. This is a two-sided, elevated-vol, low-conviction tape coiling into next week's FOMC. The laggard names the risk, and today NQ is the laggard.
psychology: Fragile flips are where accounts bleed. ES and gold are long by a whisker and still under their AVWAPs, so a chart that says 'long' is really saying 'coin flip.' The discipline today is to demand two-close confirmation before trusting any flip, and to size the ones you do take as if they can reverse on you, because at these margins they can. Pre-FOMC chop punishes conviction you have not earned.

event.name: July flash PMIs and June New Home Sales (scheduled, digested); FOMC July 28-29 ahead
event.consensus: Flash PMIs and New Home Sales near consensus, no lasting surprise.
event.actual: July flash PMIs (09:45 ET) and June New Home Sales (10:00 ET) printed and passed without a durable directional push, consistent with the two-sided tape.
event.surprise: No material surprise. The dominant forward event is the FOMC decision at 2:00 pm ET Wednesday July 29, with no new projections at this meeting.
event.nqReaction: NQ compressed and chopped rather than trended, the typical pattern into a Fed decision. It failed a reclaim of its stop and closed weak, still short.
event.crossAsset: ES and gold flipped marginally long while NQ stayed short and crude gave back part of its spike. A rotation, not a regime, ahead of the FOMC.

risk.ddProximity: Not binding. Book entered flat, full daily budget intact.
risk.dailyLossBudget: Treat as smaller than usual through the FOMC week. The Wednesday decision can gap positions held into it.
risk.sizing: Mixed regime with fragile flips and an FOMC three sessions out is a lower-conviction environment by design. Keep size below normal until a flip holds for two closes. Vol is high but plateauing, so stops need ATR-scaled room (MNQ ATR(14) 136.99) without oversizing.
risk.openRisk: Shorts (NQ, crude) have a defined risk line at their stops. The ES and gold longs are fragile with the AVWAP overhead, so their risk is wider until they reclaim their AVWAPs.
risk.note: FOMC July 28-29 next week, decision Wednesday July 29 (no dot plot). Q2 GDP advance Thursday July 30, PCE Friday July 31. The live weekend variable is Middle East oil headlines after crude's partial unwind. Current throttle: REDUCED.
